name: zones_t02_size_errors
description: Conformance test 2 (size errors, §6). With the shipped tuning (§4) and skipSizeCheck = 0: a 33 × 1 rect of type 1 exceeds max[1] = 32 -> false, error 4, no grid change. A 3 × 3 rect of type 7 is below min[7] = 4 -> error 3. A 1 × 1 rect of type 14 is below min[14] = 2 -> error 3. A type-16 request fails before the size check with error 0. The size test uses w = x2 - x1 + 1 and h = z2 - z1 + 1 against both min and max.
